items.text: UI build failure (phase-performance) is no longer reproducing — `pnpm build` succeeds. This was likely transient (stale cache or dependency issue). Only 2 failures remain: docs and playbooks.
All 4 broken doc links point to scenario-to-desktop files that were reorganized from flat docs/ into docs/guides/. The target files exist at the new paths and cover the same topics.

items.topic: Empty bas/cases/ directory — registry generation strategy
items.context: The bas/cases/ directory is empty (no test cases defined yet). Running `test-genie registry build` will scan bas/cases/ and produce a registry. If the phase requires at least one case to pass, we may need an alternative approach.

options.label: Generate registry from empty cases/ (expect empty registry to pass)
options.rationale: Simplest fix. If test-genie produces a valid empty registry.json, the playbooks phase should pass with 0 tests. This is the expected behavior for scenarios that haven't defined E2E tests yet.

options.label: Create a minimal smoke-test case in bas/cases/ before generating registry
options.rationale: Ensures the playbooks infrastructure actually works end-to-end, not just an empty pass. However, this is scope creep for a QA fix item — better as a separate backlog item.

items.topic: Link text update for renamed docs
items.context: The broken links reference old file names (SIGNING.md, CROSS_PLATFORM_BUILDS.md). The link display text in some cases says 'SIGNING.md' or references the old name. Should the display text be updated to match the new file names, or kept as-is since the link text describes the concept rather than the filename?

options.label: Update both href and display text to reflect new file names
options.rationale: Keeps documentation consistent — readers see accurate file references. Prevents confusion if someone tries to find the file by its display name.

options.label: Update only the href, keep display text as-is
options.rationale: Minimal change, reduces diff noise. Display text is conceptual ('Code Signing Guide') not filename-based in most cases.

plan_updates: Created initial plan.md with full root cause analysis, implementation steps for 2 remaining failures (docs broken links + missing playbooks registry), risk matrix, and acceptance criteria.
